questions.stem: 機器人的工作時間可以是人類的三倍，而且從不抱怨，這正是工廠老闆最看重的。
questions.answer: Robots can work three times as long as human workers without complaining, which is exactly what factory owners value most.
accepted_answers: Robots can work three times longer than humans and never complain, which is precisely what factory owners care about most.
The working hours of robots can be three times as long as those of humans, and they never complain, which is just what factory owners value most.

patterns: 倍數比較（three times as long as）
what 名詞子句（…正是…最看重的）

questions.stem: 然而，無論生產線多麼先進，由機器人製造的產品仍需要員工檢查，以確保品質。
questions.answer: However, no matter how advanced assembly lines become, products made by robots still need to be inspected by workers to ensure their quality.
accepted_answers: However, no matter how advanced production lines become, products made by robots still have to be checked by employees to make sure of their quality.
However, no matter how advanced the production line becomes, goods manufactured by robots still need workers to check them in order to ensure quality.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾（products made by robots）

1.explanation_zh: 「機器人的工作時間可以是人類的三倍」可以直接說 Robots can work three times as long as human workers（倍數放在 as long as 前面），也可以寫 three times longer than humans。「而且從不抱怨」without complaining／and never complain。「這正是工廠老闆最看重的」指前面整件事，用 , which is exactly what factory owners value most：which 代替前面整句，「…最看重的」後面沒有名詞，用 what 名詞子句。
evidence: 這正是工廠老闆最看重的
1.strategy_zh: 「是…的 X 倍」→ X times as + adj./adv. + as …；句尾「這正是…所…的」→ , which is exactly what + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：機器人的工作時間可以／是人類的三倍／而且從不抱怨／這正是工廠老闆最看重的
標的詞彙：robot（機器人）、human（人類）、complain（抱怨）、factory（工廠）、owner（老闆）、value（看重）
句型框架：S + can work + three times as long as …, which is exactly what + S + V + most

2.explanation_zh: 「然而，無論生產線多麼先進」However, no matter how advanced production lines are／become（how 後面先接形容詞，再接主詞和動詞，不加 but）。「由機器人製造的產品」把中文前面的修飾語改成過去分詞片語放在名詞後面：products made by robots（產品是被製造，用 p.p.）。「仍需要員工檢查」產品是被檢查的，用 still need to be inspected by workers；「以確保品質」用不定詞表目的 to ensure their quality。
2.strategy_zh: 「由…＋動詞＋的＋名詞」→ N + p.p. + by …；「無論多麼＋形容詞」→ no matter how + adj. + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：然而，無論生產線多麼先進／由機器人製造的產品／仍需要員工檢查／以確保品質
標的詞彙：robot（機器人）、product（產品）、check／inspect（檢查）、worker（員工）、ensure（確保）、quality（品質）
句型框架：However, no matter how + adj. + S + be, N + p.p. + by … + still need to be p.p. + to ensure …

traps.literal_error: …, this is exactly factory owners value most.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「工廠老闆最看重的」是修飾語、後面省略了名詞；英文沒有先行詞要用 what 名詞子句，而且逗號後不能直接接 this is …，要寫 , which is exactly what factory owners value most。

bonus.text: Not only can robots work three times as long as humans, but they never complain either, which is exactly what factory owners value most.
bonus.explanation_zh: Not only 放句首要倒裝（can + 主詞 + 動詞），把「工作時間長」和「從不抱怨」兩個優點並列，語氣更強；倒裝只當加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文最後用「這正是…最看重的」總結前面整件事，英文用非限定的 , which is exactly what … 指前面整句，what 子句當 is 的補語；不要用逗號直接接 this is …（會變成逗號連接兩個句子）。

1.translation: Robots can work three times as long as humans and never complain, which is exactly what factory owners value most.
1.explanation_zh: 「工作時間是人類的三倍」用倍數句 three times as long as humans；「這正是…最看重的」以非限定 which 指整個前句，接 what 名詞子句 what factory owners value most。

2.translation: However, no matter how advanced the production line is, products made by robots still need to be checked by workers to ensure their quality.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論多麼先進」用 no matter how + 形容詞；「由機器人製造的產品」用過去分詞後位修飾 made by robots；「需要員工檢查」產品是被檢查者，用被動不定詞 need to be checked；「以確保」用表目的的 to ensure。

2.translation: However, no matter how advanced the production line is, products made by robots still need to be checked by employees to ensure quality.
